nodes.label: preact entry
nodes.desc: 13 lines: re-exports render, hydrate, createElement/h, Fragment, createRef, cloneElement, Component, createContext, createPortal, toChildArray, options

nodes.label: render()
nodes.desc: Stores previous tree on parentDom._children, slices existing childNodes as excessDomChildren for hydration/mount

nodes.label: hydrate()
nodes.desc: Sets MODE_HYDRATE (1 << 5) on object vnodes then delegates to render()

nodes.label: createElement (h)
nodes.desc: Splits key/ref out of props, flattens >2 args into a children array via EMPTY_ARR.slice

nodes.label: createContext
nodes.desc: Provider is a real component: getChildContext map, subscriber Set, shouldComponentUpdate forces subscribers

nodes.label: createVNode
nodes.desc: Allocates the fixed vnode shape (type, props, key, ref, _children, _parent, _depth, _dom, _component, constructor: VNODE_MARKER, _original, _index, _flags) from one call site for V8 shape stability

nodes.label: flag bits
nodes.desc: vnode._flags: MODE_HYDRATE 1<<5, MODE_SUSPENDED 1<<7, INSERT_VNODE 1<<2, MATCHED 1<<1, REF_DETACHED 1<<3, LIS_CANDIDATE 1<<4; component._bits: COMPONENT_DIRTY 1<<3, COMPONENT_FORCE 1<<2; VNODE_MARKER = Symbol.for('pv')

nodes.label: BaseComponent
nodes.desc: Minimal base class (props, context, _bits=0); function components get it as backing instance with doRender shim

nodes.label: setState
nodes.desc: Clones state into _nextState only on first write per tick; functional updates cloned twice for immer-readonly safety (#2716)

nodes.label: enqueueRender
nodes.desc: Sets COMPONENT_DIRTY, pushes to rerenderQueue, schedules one queueMicrotask flush (or options.debounceRendering)

nodes.label: process()
nodes.desc: Sorts queue by depthSort (vnode._depth), re-renders each dirty component in place via diff(), then commitRoot

nodes.label: commitRoot
nodes.desc: Applies refQueue triples (ref, value, vnode), then drains each component's _renderCallbacks (componentDidMount/Update, layout effect states)

nodes.label: diff()
nodes.desc: Rejected if constructor !== VNODE_MARKER; class-vs-function split via prototype.render; sCU/_original bail-out breaks outer; render loop re-runs until COMPONENT_DIRTY clears (max 25); portal _parentDom swaps container

nodes.label: diffElementNodes
nodes.desc: Claims matching node from excessDomChildren by localName/nodeType, createElementNS with scoped registry, svg/math namespace tracking, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, value/checked after props

nodes.label: unmount
nodes.desc: Recursive teardown: refs, componentWillUnmount, portal-aware skipRemove, $s range-marker cleanup via _excess

nodes.label: applyRef
nodes.desc: Function refs store cleanup on the element (_refCleanup) so double-detach is a no-op; object refs set .current

nodes.label: rangeEnd
nodes.desc: Finds the closing /$s comment of a streamed Suspense range with depth counting for nested markers

nodes.label: _catchError
nodes.desc: Climbs vnode._parent for a boundary with getDerivedStateFromError/componentDidCatch, sets COMPONENT_FORCE + COMPONENT_PENDING_ERROR, rethrows if none

nodes.label: options
nodes.desc: One object seeded only with _catchError; every addon (debug, compat, hooks) wraps the previous hook value

nodes.label: diffChildren
nodes.desc: Loops new children, pulls matched old vnode via ~_index guard, queues refs in refQueue, places DOM via insert() or nextSibling cursor

nodes.label: constructNewChildrenArray
nodes.desc: Normalizes strings/arrays/reused vnodes, tracks skew between old and new indices, decrements remainingOldChildren, unmounts unmatched

nodes.label: findMatchingIndex
nodes.desc: Checks skewedIndex first, then sweeps x-1..0 and x+1..end for key+type match; ~matchingIndex keeps -1 off V8's fast path

nodes.label: LIS minimal moves
nodes.desc: On real reorder: binary-search patience sorting over LIS_CANDIDATE old indices, walk back marking non-subsequence children INSERT_VNODE

nodes.label: insert()
nodes.desc: Uses parentDom.moveBefore when available, insertBefore otherwise; skips comment $s markers; detaches stale _dom after moves (#5065)

nodes.label: getDomSibling
nodes.desc: Finds insertion cursor by walking _index+1 then climbing _parent; stops at root boundaries (props._parentDom)

nodes.label: setProperty
nodes.desc: Branches: style object diff, name[0]=='o'&&name[1]=='n' events, else property-if-'name-in-dom' (with width/height/href/list/form exceptions) then setAttribute/removeAttribute

nodes.label: setStyle
nodes.desc: Leading-dash keys go through style.setProperty (CSS custom properties), others assign style[key]

nodes.label: event proxies
nodes.desc: One real addEventListener per prop name via eventProxies map; dom._listeners swap handlers cheaply; eventClock stamp stops bubbling events hitting nodes added mid-dispatch (#3927)

nodes.label: preact/hooks
nodes.desc: Module-level currentIndex/currentComponent cursor; hooks state stored on component.__hooks._list[index]; wraps options._render, diffed, _commit, unmount

nodes.label: useReducer/useState
nodes.desc: Dispatch stores _nextValue and calls setState({}); installs a shouldComponentUpdate that bails when every _nextValue Object.is-equals its _value

nodes.label: useEffect/useLayoutEffect
nodes.desc: argsChanged uses Object.is; passive effects queue in __hooks._pendingEffects flushed after paint, layout effects ride _renderCallbacks in commit

nodes.label: flushAfterPaintEffects
nodes.desc: rAF + setTimeout(35 ms RAF_TIMEOUT) fallback; runs unmounted components' passive cleanups before new effects, routes errors via _passive

edges.label: diff in place per dirty component
